import.title: Import test cases from Excel
import.subtitle: Fill in the standard template and upload it. Suites are created automatically from the suite path.

import.file_hint: Format .xlsx, up to 5 MB, max 1000 cases.

import.strategy_hint: A case is a duplicate when its title already exists in the same suite.

import.skip_invalid_hint: The rows listed above are left out; everything else is imported.
import.nothing_to_import: Nothing would be imported with the current options.
